findings.text: This range establishes processor model identifiers by pairing an implementor code with a part code for several families including recent Arm application and Neoverse cores, Cavium ThunderX and OcteonTX2 variants, Broadcom Brahma and Vulcan, and Qualcomm Falkor Kryo and Oryon generations covering gold and silver tiers.

Additional model identifiers follow the same implementor plus part pairing for NVIDIA server cores, Fujitsu high performance computing core, HiSilicon server cores, Apple mobile and desktop efficiency and performance cores across two generations and three product tiers, Ampere server cores, and Microsoft server core.

One Fujitsu model identifier is reused as an erratum identifier, with a companion mask that excludes a specific variant and revision combination and a translation control clear mask that combines two no-fault data controls.

Range descriptor holds model and inclusive lower and upper revision bounds named model rv_min and rv_max with constructors for arbitrary intervals single variant intervals single revisions and fully open version coverage. Target descriptor holds three wide identification values named midr revidr and aidr.

Model range matching requires masked model equality together with masked variant revision falling inclusively between configured bounds, using separate masks for model versus revision plus variant portions.

Provides constant pure queries for current processor identification including full main identification value, multiprocessor affinity value, implementor field extracted from main identification, and part number field extracted from main identification.
Crash reservation uses a two megabyte alignment, a low address ceiling tied to the DMA physical limit, and a high address ceiling one past the physical address mask.
Each header in this lane defines a unique inclusion guard macro that prevents repeated inclusion and carries no behavioural effect beyond single inclusion.
Current task retrieval reads the SP_EL0 system register and interprets the value as a pointer to the running task descriptor, exposed under both a function name and a short alias.

Process context entry uses no mask bits, process context without interrupts combines interrupt and fast interrupt bits, error context adds asynchronous abort bit, and full mask covers debug interrupt abort and fast interrupt bits.

Provides always inline local interrupt masking operations to mask all, to snapshot current mask state, to snapshot then mask, to restore a snapshot, and to inherit mask state from an exception register frame.

Masking transitions interact with interrupt priority masking where active by reflecting priority state in snapshots, updating priority hardware on mask and restore, tracing hard interrupt transitions, and ordering priority writes before status register writes without extra barriers due to self synchronizing behaviour.
Debug builds warn if mask state disagrees with priority hardware expectations during mask and restore, ensuring callers do not invoke masking while already fully masked under priority debugging.

Register frame interrupt state is considered disabled when either the status interrupt bit is set or priority hardware does not report unmasked, with priority check bypassed to true when priority masking is unavailable.
Debug communications channel accessors expose status retrieval and single character receive and transmit through dedicated debug registers with barrier ordering after each data movement.

Debug status reserves bit twenty one for single step and extracts three bit event class by shifting syndrome twenty seven. Hardware breakpoint single step watchpoint software breakpoint breakpoint instruction and vector catch correspond to zero one two six four and five respectively.

Breakpoint instruction size equals normal instruction size. Sixty four bit breakpoint opcodes combine a monitor break base with distinct immediates for dynamic debug probes single step and user probes. Thirty two bit encodings provide ARM encoding 0x07f001f0 and Thumb encoding 0xde01 with Thumb two halves 0xf7f0 and 0xa000. Cache flush safety is reported as true.
Reserved architecture debug identifier is zero for future ABI extension. Hook results distinguish handled as zero from error as one.
Active exception level enumeration provides two ordered values for privileged and unprivileged levels with first as zero and second as one.
Suspended breakpoint stepping helper is a predicate that unconditionally reports false in this configuration, indicating no stepping action taken.
Firmware table access maps early and normal requests to cached mappings with matching unmap operations and allocates zeroed kernel memory for table handling.
EFI initialization is defined as a no operation. Runtime exception fixup is a predicate that always reports failure to fix, taking register state and message without effect.

EFI runtime helpers provide a virtual call wrapper through an assembly trampoline, a test for execution on the EFI runtime stack using current task and stack top, and save plus restore of interrupt mask state around runtime calls.
EFI interrupt flag mask combines debug asynchronous abort interrupt and fast interrupt bits.
Kernel image alignment for EFI is the larger of segment and thread alignments. Allocation alignment is sixty four kilobytes and allocation limit is one below two to the forty eighth power.

Maximum initrd address derives from one gigabyte alignment of image address plus half the minimum virtual address range. Minimum image alignment retains two megabyte alignment when kernel address randomization was explicitly disabled, otherwise uses EFI image alignment.

EFI page table switch updates the active page tables then reconciles saved user table base for threads when translation table branch predictor isolation via TTBR0 is active, distinguishing borrowed versus active address spaces.

Saved user table base update is a no operation when TTBR0 isolation is inactive or when the alternate configuration is selected. When active it selects reserved tables for the initial address space and otherwise combines physical table address with address space identifier before storing once to thread storage.

Address conversions translate kernel virtual to physical without debugging, hide relocation for symbol physical addresses, extract low sixteen bits as address space identifier, and convert physical table address to table base register format with a fifty two bit aware variant and a direct variant.

Address space switching uses reserved user tables for the initial space and otherwise delegates to context checking. Reserved table installation writes the reserved base then orders with a barrier. User table switch rejects the swapper tables and delegates to low level switch with physical address.

Context switch first attempts a lock free fast path when generation matches and active identifier can be refreshed atomically, otherwise takes a lock to allocate a new identifier on generation mismatch, flushes translation buffers if pending, then applies branch predictor hardening and installs tables unless deferred for emulated isolation. Low level install programs both table bases with address space identifier and optional common not private and software isolation bits, orders with barriers, and applies a Cavium specific cache maintenance workaround when enabled.

Slow path context allocation serializes generation check and identifier allocation under a raw spinlock held with interrupts saved, with translation buffer flush pending flags cleared under the same critical section.

Table switching hazards include forbidden use of swapper tables for user space, skipped common not private optimization for reserved identifier, required barrier ordering around table writes and translation invalidations, and model specific maintenance after table updates.

Public context switch entry points allow higher layers to request checked switch with identifier management, direct physical table install with identifier programming, and post update workaround handling.

Interrupt mask handling warns under priority debugging when hardware priority and status bits disagree, and requires callers to preserve tracing balance between mask and unmask transitions including inheritance from exception frames.
